The Senior Director QA will sit on the GPD&A leadership team, who are responsible for the management and operational development of strategy for Gilead Quality Distribution & QA Operations within each market Gilead supply, and the individual is expected to actively participate in, and support the goals of this Leadership team. The role also requires someone with a track record of excellent people leadership & influencing skills, experience in developing & implementing strategic goals, as well as hands-on experience supporting multiple QA operating models across a global commercial network and delivering successful governance & QA operating processes. The primary responsibilities include, but not limited to, the following: • Serve as a key member of the GPD&A Leadership Team, who are collectively responsible for implementation of cohesive & effective QA processes across the Gilead distribution network as well as developing medium- and long-term strategic plans for all regions, which supports the overall strategic plans for the quality organization. • Coach and mentor direct reports to drive independence, development, and performance & provide leadership to ensure a safe, respectful, and inclusive work environment. • Manage financial budget, resource and workload balance with team to ensure local QA activities are performed to meet timelines and quality & compliance expectations in an equitable manner as well as ensuring that key performance indicators are monitored and reported, and key project timelines & milestones are tracked. Provides guidance on prioritization when necessary. • Act as Senior QA advisor to in-country & cluster (group of countries) QA leads with interpreting the local & regional regulatory requirements as they pertain to the distribution of Gilead products • Drive the Corporate Quality Support Model (CQSM) programme, implemented to support RA colleagues when performing local in-country QA role, and together with Regional RA Leaders, implement & lead a governance process for the CQSM. • Act as senior liaison with Gilead’s distribution partners (in QA International markets) related to escalations regulatory inspectorate bodies. • Provide leadership for local market activities across QA International region supporting product recall and support periodic product recall challenges to ensure Gilead’s in-country distribution operations are in a state of continuous readiness in the event of needing to support product recall or other types of market action. • Lead highly complex investigations, including development and implementation of corrective and preventative action (CAPA), as required. • Partner with QA colleagues & regional RA to develop strategies supporting Gilead’s in-country QA operations, including introduction of standards, processes & procedures supporting these strategies. • Provide expertise and guidance in interpreting governmental regulations, agency guidelines and internal policies to assure continued compliance. • Collaborate cross-functionally and geographically with key stakeholders to establish strong working relationships with quality groups, colleagues in Regulatory Affairs, Commercial Operations & Legal functions as well as other Gilead global functions and external distribution partners. • Act as an internal escalation contact supporting complex and high impact quality issues, concerns, and decisions. • Champion the responsible use of artificial intelligence and digital tools to identify, develop, and implement efficiencies across QA International activities, while ensuring appropriate governance, data integrity, regulatory compliance, and human oversight. • Prime QA representative on cross-functional regional/global projects & process improvement initiatives of considerable impact to the business. • Act as deputy for the Executive Director, as required, supporting complex and high impact quality-related issues, escalations & other topics. Education & Experience • Significant, relevant experience and a bachelor’s degree in science or related fields, MD, PharmD, PhD or an advanced business degree such as an MBA. Alternatively, broad experience in pharmaceutical warehouse & distribution required. • Comprehensive knowledge and experience in quality assurance in highly regulated distribution environments. • Prior people management experience required. • Broad experience across areas like customer service, warehouse operations, logistics & transport required and understanding of Oral Solid Dosage, Parenteral and Aseptic operations is beneficial. Knowledge, Skills & Competencies • Demonstrates in-depth understanding and application of GDP principles, concepts, and standards in markets covered by QA International region, as well as having an appreciation of them in other regions across the globe. • Capable of developing complex concepts, techniques, and standards and new applications based on quality principles and theories. • Anticipates shifts in industry trends and regulatory environment that will impact Gilead’s business needs and positions the function to respond accordingly • Demonstrates strong knowledge of aseptic processing, solid dose and general pharmaceutical manufacturing. • Capable of developing solutions to complex problems, which require a high degree of ingenuity, creativity, and innovativeness, and where precedent may not exist. • Demonstrates extensive knowledge of industry best practices and trends. • Demonstrates excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, as well as excellent influencing skills. • Is comfortable interacting with regulatory agencies as needed and possesses the ability to represent Gilead in public forums. • Demonstrates the ability to identify, understand and exceed customer expectations. • Demonstrates experience and ability to manage staff. • Demonstrates the ability to initiate and support change and respond to change requirements by continually striving to improve process or business areas, consistent with organizational strategy • Demonstrates knowledge of artificial intelligence and the ability to use approved AI tools responsibly to support efficiency, including recognizing limitations, critically reviewing outputs, protecting confidential information, and maintaining appropriate human oversight. You will tackle large-scale, highly ambiguous customer problems that span services, workflows, and organizations, establish experience vision and strategy where the path forward is not yet defined, and influence product direction across AWS AI Services. This is a particularly exciting moment to work in this space. Generative AI and agents are changing not only what developers can build, but how software itself is built, evaluated, deployed, and operated. Many of the interaction models for these technologies are still emerging. You will have the opportunity to work on capabilities at the frontier of AI development and help define patterns that do not yet have established answers. You will work at the intersection of AI platform strategy, developer experience, and emerging interaction models, translating sophisticated technical capabilities into experiences that help builders move from experimentation to production. You’ll partner with senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Applied Science, Research, and UX to identify systemic customer problems, create alignment around a future-state vision, and turn that vision into shipped experiences. This is hands-on design role. You’ll move fluidly between strategy and execution, framing problems, conducting and using customer research, mapping complex systems and workflows, prototyping new interaction models, defining end-to-end experiences, and working directly with engineering teams to ship them. Key job responsibilities Lead strategic, portfolio-level design initiatives. Take on some of the most consequential and ambiguous customer problems across Bedrock, AgentCore, and the broader AWS AI/ML portfolio. Many of these challenges will cross product and organizational boundaries, requiring you to see the larger system, define a clear experience vision, and bring multiple teams together around a path forward. Define the future of AI developer experiences. Help shape how builders create, evaluate, deploy, govern, and operate generative AI applications and agents on AWS. In a space where many interaction patterns are still being invented, you’ll have the opportunity to establish new models for how developers work with AI and influence experiences that span the console, APIs, SDKs, and CLI. Shape the technology, not just the interface. Great developer experiences often begin well below the UI. You’ll go deep into the architecture, APIs, data models, and developer workflows behind the products you design, working directly with senior engineers and technical leaders to make them more intuitive. That may mean influencing the structure of an API, challenging an abstraction that exposes too much underlying complexity, or rethinking terminology and defaults before they become difficult to change. You should be comfortable engaging Engineering at this level and advocating for a different technical solution when a technically valid one creates a poor customer experience. Bring clarity to ambiguous problems. You’ll often begin with an emerging technology, an unmet customer need, or a broad strategic opportunity rather than a defined set of requirements. Use customer insight, systems thinking, prototyping, and strong product judgment to make the problem concrete, explore what is possible, and help teams converge on the right direction. Take on complex experiences yourself, explore alternatives and tradeoffs, prototype rapidly, validate ideas with customers, and carry the work from early concept through detailed execution. Move quickly while maintaining a high bar for interaction design, visual craft, and the details that make technical products easier to understand and use. Create coherence across the portfolio. Look beyond individual products to identify where customers encounter fragmentation across AWS AI Services. Establish shared interaction models, frameworks, and patterns that solve those problems systematically and help Bedrock, AgentCore, and adjacent services feel like a connected builder experience. Influence across organizational boundaries. Many of the problems you’ll own cannot be solved by one team. Build trusted relationships with senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Science, and UX, bring customer evidence and design thinking into strategic decisions, and create alignment when teams have different technical constraints, priorities, or points of view. Raise the design bar beyond your own work. Your impact as a Principal designer should extend beyond the experiences you personally ship. Provide thoughtful critique and direction, develop approaches that other teams can reuse, mentor designers tackling complex technical problems, and help elevate the quality of design across the broader organization.

jobs.description: Prime Video (PV) is seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager (TPM) to own Operational Excellence and Development Efficiency across the business. Reporting directly to the Director of READI, this is a strategic, single-threaded leadership role for a builder who thrives in ambiguity and can set direction where the problem itself is not yet defined. As a Principal TPM, you will operate across VP organizations, exercising broad strategic influence over how Prime Video plans, measures, and improves the operational health of its services and the productivity of its engineers. You will own high-visibility operating mechanisms — most notably the Prime Video Quarterly Operations Review — and set the overall strategy, goals, and initiatives for Operational Excellence across PV. You will manage significantly complex, cross-functional initiatives, remediate endemic problems, and force-multiply your impact through the mechanisms and standards you create. This is a role for someone who is regularly escalated to, rather than one who escalates. Key job responsibilities Operational Excellence Strategy & Goals Define and own the multi-year strategy, annual goals, and initiative portfolio for Operational Excellence across Prime Video, aligning teams and organizations toward a simple, coherent approach. Establish the operational metrics, standards, and paved-road practices that define what “good” looks like for PV services — covering availability, resilience, incident management, and operational readiness. Set and track org-level operational goals planning, translating leadership priorities into measurable outcomes and holding teams accountable to them. Remediate critical and endemic operational problems by identifying systemic root causes and driving durable, cross-org fixes rather than point solutions. High-Visibility Mechanisms (PV Quarterly Operations Review) Own the Prime Video Quarterly Operations Review end-to-end — its agenda, data, narrative, and follow-through — as the authoritative forum where PV leadership inspects operational health and commits to improvements. Design, run, and continuously improve the portfolio of operating mechanisms (weekly/monthly business and ops reviews, metrics dashboards, and governance cadences) that create predictable inspection and drive action. Curate crisp, accurate, and timely written narratives and data for senior leaders (up to and including VPs and S-Team-facing readouts), ensuring decisions are well-informed and action items are tracked to closure. Create the connective tissue between mechanisms so that signals surfaced in one forum reliably drive prioritization, resourcing, and roadmap decisions across PV. Development Efficiency Own the strategy for improving developer productivity and delivery velocity across PV — reducing friction in the software lifecycle from design through deployment and operations. Define and instrument developer efficiency metrics (e.g., build and deployment health, cycle time, change failure rate, time-to-recover) and use them to target the highest-leverage investments. Drive adoption of paved-road tooling, standards, and best practices that simplify how PV teams build and operate, eliminating undifferentiated heavy lifting and unnecessary process. Partner with builder-tools and infrastructure teams to unblock innovation and increase the speed and safety of delivery at scale. Cross-Org Influence & Force Multiplication Operate across VP organizations with broad strategic influence, building consensus, securing commitments, and negotiating positive outcomes among senior engineering and product leaders. Drive clarity in ambiguity — frame problems that are not yet defined, align stakeholders on the path forward, and deliver with complete independence. Force-multiply through the mechanisms, standards, and structures you create, raising the operational bar across teams without being in the critical path of every decision. Actively develop the TPM community at PV — mentoring senior TPMs, contributing to promotion assessments, and elevating program-management craft across the organization. A day in the life No two days look the same, but the through-line is mechanism ownership and strategic influence. You might begin the morning diving deep into operational metrics ahead of the Quarterly Operations Review — pressure-testing the data, sharpening the narrative, and pre-aligning VP-org leaders on the decisions that need to be made. Midday, you facilitate a working session with engineering directors to unblock a cross-org resilience initiative, making the trade-off calls between business opportunity, resources, and long-term sustainability. In the afternoon, you shift to development efficiency — reviewing delivery-velocity trends, identifying the systemic bottlenecks slowing teams down, and shaping the paved-road investments that will remove them. Throughout, you are the person leaders are escalated to when operational health is at risk, and the owner who ensures every commitment coming out of a mechanism is tracked to closure. Your success is measured not by the work you personally execute, but by the durable systems, standards, and mechanisms you leave behind. About the team READI is a central function in Prime Video that drives strategy, tooling, and programs for Scale Readiness, Operational Excellence, Resilience & Observability, and Development Efficiency. READI’s value as a central team relies heavily on outward-facing influence: its strategy, decisions, and guidance are amplified across all of PV. Prime Video operates a global, high-scale streaming service, spending hundreds of millions in infrastructure and allocating hundreds of engineers to operational load each year — a surface area where disciplined operational rigor and improved development efficiency translate directly into customer experience, cost, and speed of innovation. Today, ownership of PV-wide Operational Excellence strategy and its supporting mechanisms is distributed, creating diffusion of responsibility and inconsistent standards across teams. This role exists to close that gap: to be the single-threaded owner who defines what operational excellence means for PV, instruments it, runs the mechanisms that inspect it, and drives the initiatives that continuously raise the bar.
